_comment: Figures read off each site by eye, with the date they were read. Three of these accounts cannot
be scraped: DigitalCore's API key returns 403 on every user endpoint, BTSCHOOL's login is behind
a captcha, and C411 has no stored credentials. Without this file their rows on the dashboard are
empty, which is how a thin ratio goes unnoticed. Every panel shows the age of the reading next to
the number, because a figure with no date is worse than no figure.
Sizes are GiB, matching what the sites display. Update whenever a profile page is in front of you.

digitalcore.note: leech bonus shown as 12%, class Rogue, daily login streak day 2 of 7

c411.note: 50 of those 52.2 GB are the signup credit: only 2.3 GB was really uploaded, and the credit does not grow back

btschool.note: newbie assessment: needs 50 GB up, 50 GB down and 6000 points by the deadline, or a donation

retrotoon.note: site-wide freeleech until about 2026-09-30, so downloads cost nothing against ratio
